title: Failed payouts retry on their own

proposal.problem: About 40 shop payouts a week fail and support retries each one by hand
proposal.hypothesis: We believe retrying failed payouts on their own will cut manual retries by 80 percent, because most failures are short bank timeouts
proposal.impact: Shops get paid on time and support gets hours back
proposal.first_step: Ship retries for bank timeouts only
proposal.pitch: Shops stop waiting on support to get paid
proposal.owner_check: No ticket or doc in Payments or Support owns this

title: Booking reminders that shops never see

draft_proposal.problem: Shops in a different time zone from their owner get the morning reminder after the first booking
draft_proposal.hypothesis: We believe sending reminders in the shop's own time zone will cut no shows by a fifth, because late reminders are the top support reason
draft_proposal.lever: The reminder job is a small change in a service you review often
draft_proposal.first_step: Count late reminders for one week
draft_proposal.pitch: Shops see the day's bookings before the first rider arrives
draft_proposal.owner_check: Booking squad has no open ticket for it

title: Repair quotes that change after booking

proposal.problem: One in nine repair quotes goes up after the rider books, and those riders cancel three times as often
proposal.hypothesis: We believe asking shops to confirm parts before booking will halve changed quotes
proposal.metric: Share of bookings whose quote changes
proposal.lever: Needs the Booking squad, you would lead the data side
proposal.first_step: Ask Ama whether Booking plans to touch quotes
